Alexei / Lila / procurement — thanks for the call today. Below are terse notes, the Q&A synthesis, and actions. Recorded the first 30m for internal reference; recording link follows in related_links.

Call summary (14:00–14:38 PST):
- Attendees: Alexei Voronov (EquinoxAI), Lila Chen (EquinoxAI), procurement@equinoxai.com; Naomi Feldman, Irene Choi, Marissa Cole (Redwood).
- Primary ask: map CAIQ/SIG to available evidence and confirm options for Private deployment with CMK support and log access policies.

Key points / clarifications:
- Deployment modes: Redwood supports Hosted API, Dedicated (reserved GPU pools), and Private (VPC/on-prem). For strict residency/controls you should evaluate Private; Dedicated can be isolated but is still Redwood-managed. (Irene to share a short matrix below.)
- KMS: Customer-managed keys supported for Private deployments via KMS/HSM integrations; with Dedicated we can support CMK in specific partner regions (requires contract appendix).
- Logs: Inference request logs include request_id, model_id, timestamp, token_count, anonymized user_id by default. We do not log full prompt content for hosted inference unless explicitly configured via audit options. Default retention is 90 days; archival to customer S3 is possible for Private/Dedicated.
- Long-context KV caching: Dedicated supports 32k sequences but persistence of KV cache across restarts is not guaranteed unless using our dedicated sticky-node option; we discussed tradeoffs for throughput vs persistence.

Q&A synthesis (shortened):
Q1: Will you provide SOC 2 report?
A1: Yes — we can provide a SOC 2 Type II summary and auditor statement. Attached: SOC2-summary.pdf (redacted).

Q2: Can we get an annotated CAIQ showing coverage?
A2: Yes — we will return an annotated CAIQ/CAIQ workbook. Attached: CAIQ-annotated.xlsx (work-in-progress).

Q3: What network diagrams do you provide?
A3: We provided a sanitized network-diagram.png during the call and will follow up with the Private deployment architecture appendix if you move forward.

Action items / owners / due dates:
- Naomi: Share SOC2-summary.pdf and CAIQ-annotated.xlsx (done; attached). Due: 2026-01-15 (completed).
- Irene Choi: Produce a 1-pg matrix contrasting Dedicated vs Private for data residency and KMS options; include notes on KV cache persistence. Due: 2026-01-18.
- Marissa Cole: Open procurement thread and provision contract appendix template for Dedicated/Private options; loop in legal. Due: 2026-01-20.
- Alexei / EquinoxAI: Upload your CAIQ workbook to the Drive link and confirm must-have evidence items (SOC2, logs, network appendix). Due: 2026-01-16.

Attachments delivered: SOC2-summary.pdf (PDF), CAIQ-annotated.xlsx (Excel), network-diagram.png (PNG), redwood-security-intake-form.pdf (PDF).

Next steps: Irene will send the Dedicated vs Private matrix by Monday; Marissa will start the contract prep. Naomi will reach out if we need to run a deeper artifact sprint (e.g., to carve out in-scope systems or provide log export samples).

Naomi Feldman
